step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture shows an automated server migration system moving on-premises workloads to AWS target accounts. First, the Application Discovery Service gathers metadata from On-Premises servers, while CloudEndure handles continuous block-level volume replication to an EC2 Hot Replica in AWS. The Migration Team populates operational metadata in DynamoDB and triggers migration actions via Slack. Slack invokes the Migration Factory EC2 instance, which coordinates with Application Discovery Service and CloudEndure, bakes an AMI from the hot replica, shares the AMI across account boundaries to the target account, and launches the target EC2 instance with the configured parameters.
